title: happy coffee daily magic medium roast whole bean coffee, 12 oz., notes of berries & alchemy, responsibly grown & harvested in South America.
features: seriously delicious: start your morning off right with happy’s daily magic medium roast whole bean coffee, thoughtfully sourced and expertly blended with notes of berries and alchemy.
a happy medium: our whole bean coffee gives you the freedom to grind your coffee just the way you like it– perfect for drip, pourover, French press, AeroPress and more.
100% arabica beans: we source the best beans from South America, then carefully roast the beans for a balanced, fruity and chocolatey finish in every sip.
great coffee takes time: unlike so many other coffees that are roasted in just several minutes, we take our sweet time to optimize consistency and taste.

together, we can make things better: we've partnered with NAMI, the largest mental health organization in the US, to provide meaningful support wherever you are. NAMI is dedicated to building better lives for the millions affected by mental illness.
